notes.title: Rise Up Trial - Alpha Release
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that the Rise Up Trial is now in a playable state! Here’s what’s new in this update:

Movable and Rotatable Meshes:
All technical systems for creating, moving, and rotating meshes have been tested and are now fully integrated. This means the foundation for future complex levels is ready to go.

Character Abilities:
The abilities for Dash, Double Jump, and Reverse have been created, tested, and are now available to use. These abilities will play a major role in overcoming the various obstacles in Rise Up.

New Sub-Level for Testing:
We’ve built a small sub-level to give you a taste of what the trial will feel like. This level will let you test the mechanics and get a sense of how the gameplay will evolve.

Please note that everything is still in the alpha stage, so some elements might be buggy or incomplete. We’re actively working on polishing the experience, and your feedback is incredibly valuable during this phase!

Thank you for your support, and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts as you try out Rise Up!
